'''Hacken Berge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] who worked for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic Library]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. He traveled to the ruined world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in search of the fabled [[Promised Land]], and enlisted the help of a Republic-allied individual to learn the fates of the lost [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]], Hacken Berge was a native of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Sometime during the Cold War, Berge began to work for the [[Galactic Library]]&mdash;as a historian.<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3643 BBY]], Berge began studying the journals of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], the great [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hero of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TOR" /> He took particular interest in Revan's adventures on the former ecumenopolis [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], which was [[Destruction of Taris|destroyed]] by Revan's former apprentice [[Darth Malak]] in an attempt to kill Revan and [[Bastila Shan]], Revan's later wife. While on Taris, Revan had ventured into the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] and encountered the [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]]. Revan had helped the group's [[Promised One|leader]], [[Rukil]], find a route to the mysterious [[Promised Land]] by finding a set of [[Promised Land journals|journals]] describing the way.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

As the Outcasts had departed for the Promised Land before the bombardment, their fate was unknown. Determined to discover the truth, Berge traveled to Taris, which was being slowly [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|rebuilt]] by the Republic. He set up a base at [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]], where he began to search for any trace of the Outcasts. When a Republic-allied individual arrived at the base, Hacken enlisted their help in his search. He had discovered signs pointing toward the ruins of [[Transport Station 5]], which was recently excavated, but the area was infested with [[rakghoul]]s.<ref name="TOR" />
